mapper.insert: insert into message (type, order_id, order_number, content, is_read, create_time) values (#{type}, #{orderId}, #{orderNumber}, #{content}, #{isRead}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, type, order_id, order_number, content, is_read, create_time from message order by create_time desc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(*) from message where is_read = 0
mapper.update: update message set is_read = 1 where is_read = 0
